messages.subject: estimating psi for t+1 ect
parts:
I have seen a few posts in here about how to derive estimates of psi for subsequent seasons using coltex, but I have found the answers and work arounds lacking.  

Using:
 psi_t = psi_{t-1}*phi_{t-1} + (1-psi_{t-1})*gamma_{t-1}  

I end up with estimates lower than my naive estimate for at least one of my seasons. 

I have tried calculating psi by hand using the probability that I missed a critter during every session, but I think there is something wrong with my math/logic because the results are too high and I do not have the same estimate for psi 1 as unmarked.

The equation I have is:

psi2 = (n[2,] + (p[2,]-n[2,])*m)/p[2,])

n= # of sites with at least one observation
p= # of sites
m= probability that I missed it every time (1-plogis(p))^3 (I have 3 survey sessions)

Any help on id'ing where I am going wrong would be greatly appreciated
